_about: proto-kitchen (Zafar's rapid prototype, 1 Nov): the eggs station's own data (js/cook/stations/eggs.js; the order is recipes.eggs in data/cook.json). `station`: its name, goal and one line per phase (the grown-ups' '?' box). `words`: the station's own item catalogue (pictures for the helper card); their words are the engine's. `mechanic.levels`: cookMs how long an egg takes to be ready (the ring reaches its green), room how many eggs the pot and the pan each hold (Zafar: room for several), shakers whether the salt and pepper are on the shelf, meal the window's sky at the table (breakfast, lunch or dinner: one setting, the sky changes; Zafar's notes). Sprint 18 wave 2 (s18-g-eggs, 8 Nov): the station reads its art and places from items and scene (Cook.data.settings.eggs); mechanic.levels stays its per-level knobs.

station.name: Eggs
station.verb: Boil or fry, then the plates
station.goal: Each person says how they want their egg. Tap the bowl for an egg, then the pot to boil it or the pan to fry it. When its ring is green, tap it, then tap their plate. Then tap the tray to take it to the table.

phases.eggs: Tap the bowl, then the pot (boiled) or the pan (fried).
phases.plates: When an egg's ring is green, tap it, then tap the plate of the person who asked.
phases.serve: Tap the tray to take it to the table.

kitchen.about: Sprint 18 prep (7 Nov), the settings every kitchen game keeps (STD-F1-03): recipe, scene, items (the art each uses, its size class L/M/S, its engine word), vocab, lines, end, gaps, assets. Added beside the station's own station/words/mechanic keys, which the station reads today and are untouched; wave 2's builder moves the station onto the new keys and deletes the code it copied. Art: block 1 (sources/art/s17-art1/), cut by assets/cook/proto/_cut/s18-prep.cut.json; sizes are the largest drawn size on the 1600x900 stage x1.5, never above the sheet. Words are the engine's ids only: a word or line the engine has no Kutchi for shows as its English in grey italic and is a row in docs/language/recording-sheet.md; `gaps` lists them as of 7 Nov (the engine is the source).

recipe.ref: data/cook.json recipes.eggs (its slots and say-lines live there until wave 2 moves them here)
recipe._levels: As recipes.eggs.slots today (people byLevel 1,2,3,3). cookMs, room, shakers and the meal's sky by level are mechanic.levels (the station reads them now).

scene.view: T the hob (two burners, the pot left, the pan right), then E the table
scene.bgByMeal: mechanic.levels[].meal picks the key: L1-L2 breakfast, L3 lunch, L4 dinner

bgIsland.note: EM and EN cut at crop_y 0 so the island's back edge lands within 3 px of the master's (service-master-v2: 1058 of 1350 = 705 of 900); EM and EN match each other exactly (row 679)

people.note: Nana, Ma, Ali (cousin), Nani: the counter characters, 470 px, standing behind the table

table._note: the table scene on the meal's kitchen (scene.bg): the people stand behind the island (its back edge at y 705), each plate slides onto the island at their seat (the breakfast and night kitchens' three wooden trays at x 457, 800, 1143, measured from bg-kitchen-morning.webp); the cat on the island's left end (a placeholder until Simba)

body._note: the round body (cx, cy: its centre as fractions of the canvas) and the water inside it (rIn, of the width), measured from egg-pot-boil.webp: handles left and right, body centred

the round body (handle down): its centre (cx, cy, fractions of the canvas), its diameter (d) and the oil inside it (rIn), fractions of the width (fry-pan-oil.webp); drawn.body is the body's drawn diameter

egg._note: whole eggs lifted from the bowl; the crack at the rim; the shells after

friedEgg._note: in the pan, by the ring's progress; raw is partial alpha

boiledEgg._note: no Kutchi yet: grey English. In the pot it is the whole egg; on a plate it stands in its cup (eggCup).

bowl._note: tap: an egg lifts out; the picture follows the count left

eggCupTop._note: a boiled egg lands in its cup on the tray's plate; one canvas

plate._note: the served plate, side-on, slides to each person

eggCupServed._note: soft and hard are drawn but the game does not ask for them: nothing wired to them (no mechanic added)

cat.note: Placeholder crops (the 1 Nov mock-ups) the station loads today until wave 2 moves it onto this file's art. Simba's real sheet waits (art plan Q6).

lines.ask: recipe say-lines (frames order, need, and, no)
lines._note: Lang.line keys the station says; each built by the engine

end.note: The round ends on chai's progress display (the kit's end), never a frown. A plate that is not what they asked for gets a neutral face and the soft sound; the child can redo until the step moves on.
